name: 富途OpenD安装
examples_zh: 在我的 macOS 电脑上安装富途 OpenD，并升级 Python futu-api SDK 到最新版本。
检查当前 Linux 服务器是否已安装 Futu OpenD；如果版本过旧，请下载并替换为最新版。
帮我配置 Windows 的富途开发环境，安装 OpenD 后验证 futu-api 能成功连接。
examples_en: Install Futu OpenD on my macOS machine and upgrade the Python futu-api SDK to the latest version.
Check whether Futu OpenD is installed on this Linux server; if it is outdated, download and replace it with the latest version.
Set up the Futu development environment on Windows, install OpenD, and verify that futu-api can connect successfully.
description_zh: 富途 OpenD 一键安装与 SDK 升级（Win/Mac/Linux）
description_en: Futu OpenD one-click install and Python SDK upgrade (Win/Mac/Linux)
